# Director Readiness Resolution

## Evidence
The final matrix passed Better V2, intuitive, future-HUD, source gates, and 43/43 deterministic tests, then Director threw inside its first interactive browser expression.

The Director test uniquely relied on a fixed 850ms sleep before querying controls. Newer Olam browser tests already use `BrowserWaits` for concrete DOM readiness.

## Resolution
`director-intelligence-smoke.cjs` was rewritten in full to use `BrowserWaits` and wait for:
- prompt section;
- camera suggestion;
- golden style lane;
- frame recipe trigger;
- live 100% coverage update;
- frames-mode activation;
- contextual recipe rendering.

All prior assertions remain: geometry, collapsed guide, initial coverage, suggestion content, focus/node identity, ingredient state, style append, reference-mode transition, overflow, console errors, network failures.

NEXT_ACTION: run Director alone on fresh ports. If green, rerun the complete five-browser release graph including legacy.
